title: FORGE message envelope
description: Required fields carried by every inter-agent message (ICD-4, v1.2). work_package_id is 'wp-none' for workflow-scoped messages not tied to a work package. trace_id is a read-only mirror of the 32-hex OpenTelemetry trace ID (OBS-1). data_origin and trust_state implement DAT-2: only TRUSTED messages are accepted at subscribe by any agent other than Cyber Trust; rejection is audited.

trace_id.description: Read-only mirror of the OpenTelemetry W3C trace ID (OBS-1).
